## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New plugin configuration, gameplay mechanic, or automation script
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix, permission adjustment, or configuration resolution
- [ ] `refactor`: Configuration restructuring without behavioral changes
- [ ] `chore`: Manifest update, dependency bump, or script maintenance
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Verified syntax of all modified YAML and JSON configurations.
- [ ] No binary `.jar` files added to the commit.
- [ ] `server-manifest.json` updated if new plugins or server cores are added/modified.
- [ ] No hardcoded bot tokens, webhooks, or sensitive server credentials.
- [ ] Verified server starts cleanly with `.\run.ps1` or `./run.sh`.
